ForgeBoard
ForgeBoard - model services for OpenClaw
Stop all model services to free VRAM. Vision, embedding, router and llama-swap stay running.
Row start/stop affects only that model: start loads it, stop unloads it.
Swapper-backed models unload only and keep their service; big-model tiers stop the service too.

Engine safety

Idle unload (ttl) is written into the generated swapper config (1800 s). Card reserve is not a separate cache file - it lives here.

Card reserve (safety margin, written into the engine tier files)

These numbers are what the engine keeps free on each card. They live in the tier files; writing them backs up every file first and reads the values back to confirm. Applying them needs a restart of the big model.
Show the value in each tier file
Tier file First card Other cards
Switching does not restart services and does not interrupt a running answer (the gateway queues it to the next safe moment). Scheduled jobs and heartbeats are listed but not selected by default.

Scheduled jobs and heartbeats

Read-only here on purpose: to change the model a job uses, ask your OpenClaw assistant to do it - this panel writes nothing.
Changing the heartbeat or compaction model needs an OpenClaw gateway restart.
